name: Jan Novotný
bio:
Jan developed a keen interest in motorsport from a young age, attending local rallies with his father. He quickly grasped the financial aspects of racing, recognizing the crucial role sound financial management plays in a team's success. After graduating with a degree in Economics from the University of Economics, Prague, he pursued his passion by seeking opportunities within the motorsport industry.

Prior to joining MP Motorsport, Jan honed his skills at a regional accounting firm, gaining experience managing budgets and financial reporting for small businesses. He brings a meticulous and analytical approach to his role as Finance Controller, ensuring that all financial operations are accurate and compliant. He's particularly adept at identifying cost-saving opportunities and optimizing resource allocation.

Jan's ambition extends beyond simply managing finances; he aims to contribute strategically to the team's overall performance. His ability to quickly understand complex financial data and communicate it effectively to technical and management staff sets him apart.

physical.description: Jan is a young man with a focused gaze and a serious demeanor.

quirks: Insists on color-coding all financial spreadsheets
Taps his pen rhythmically when deep in thought
